title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage Final Credits: Paystride Fees Credited
content:
With a final credit on a lost or stolen card claim of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan, the Paystride fees credited follow the claimed transaction.

| Claimed transaction | Fees credited |
|---|---|
| carried Paystride fees: an out-of-network ATM fee, an international ATM fee or a foreign transaction fee | those fees less any part of them already returned by refund or correction |
| a domestic out-of-network ATM withdrawal with no out-of-network ATM fee because it was one of its pay period's free withdrawals | 1.95, the Advantage out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee, for the free withdrawal it used |
| otherwise | nothing |

For a claim that the final claim credit schedule for the Advantage plan prices, and only for such a claim, the fees the final credit credits are not corrected again. A fee credited within a final credit that the final claim credit schedule for the Advantage plan prices, and only such a fee, is not corrected again. The other lost or stolen card claim schedules of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account state their own.

*Hypothetical:* a domestic out-of-network withdrawal that was the third of its pay period, beyond the two free withdrawals, carries a 1.95 fee. If the fee was not returned, 1.95 is credited. If it was corrected already, nothing is credited.
